edition: RFC 4180-style delimited text; Python csv module (stdlib, Python 3.12+)

operations.name: parse
operations.description: Parse delimited bytes with an explicit mapping into typed rows with row provenance

limitations: No format guessing: delimiter, encoding, header, column types, number locale and date formats are declared by the mapping
Multi-line quoted fields are supported; malformed quoting fails the whole file
Files above the configured size limit are rejected rather than partially read
Export-side formula neutralisation is provided as a helper; this adapter itself only reads
